mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates and stimulates risk appetite, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional triggers.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% for two consecutive months signals weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction signal falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production growth exceeding 0.5% monthly (INDPRO) drives manufacturing expansion that boosts corporate profit expectations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.0% (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without additional triggers.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals potential monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL yoy growth exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and declines in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction signal falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market expansion with monthly HOUST growth exceeding 0.3% boosts consumer spending and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods when HOUST growth exceeds 0.3%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.
